title: Glowing alarm clock
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- clock body -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='32' fill='#e8436a'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='32' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fab' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- inner face -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='24' fill='#ffe9c9'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='24' fill='none' stroke='#ffc078' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- bells -->
  <circle cx='24' cy='28' r='10' fill='#f6b73c'/>
  <circle cx='24' cy='28' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#ffd97a' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='28' r='10' fill='#f6b73c'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='28' r='10' fill='none' stroke='#ffd97a' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <!-- bell hammers -->
  <rect x='22' y='34' width='4' height='9' rx='2' fill='#c94f6d'/>
  <rect x='74' y='34' width='4' height='9' rx='2' fill='#c94f6d'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <rect x='28' y='83' width='9' height='8' rx='3' fill='#c94f6d'/>
  <rect x='63' y='83' width='9' height='8' rx='3' fill='#c94f6d'/>
  <!-- clock hands -->
  <line x1='50' y1='54' x2='50' y2='38' stroke='#4a6fa5' stroke-width='3.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='54' x2='63' y2='60' stroke='#4a6fa5' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='3.5' fill='#4a6fa5'/>
  <!-- tick marks -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='2' fill='#d9a441'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='75' r='2' fill='#d9a441'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='54' r='2' fill='#d9a441'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='54' r='2' fill='#d9a441'/>
  <!-- glow rings -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='38' fill='none' stroke='#ffb3c7' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.45'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='54' r='43' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fab' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.25'/>
</svg>
